name: [Portal] Design: admin ↔ Partner Portal switcher in the header (design)
description:
### Summary

Partners with the `partnerPortal` module active have no visible way to move between the regular admin of their project and the Partner Portal. The portal's entry in the admin menu will be hidden. When a partner opens a portal URL, they get the portal's own header and sidebar (). This task is design only: it decides how the partner gets from the admin into the portal and, for now, how they get back. The preferred entry is a link or switcher in the admin's top header, shown only when the module is active. The way back is a temporary „Back to shop“ (or similar) element in the portal header. Implementation goes into separate tickets once the design is approved.

### Why?

Once the menu row is hidden, the portal can only be reached by typing its URL. Partners need a discoverable entry point, and while the portal shell has no other route out, they also need a way back.

### What?

A Figma design of both directions of the switch: where the entry sits in the admin header, how it looks, and its label. Also where „Back to shop“ sits in the reduced portal header, and how both behave on mobile.

### Acceptance Criteria

Figma frame for the entry point in the admin top header (desktop and mobile).

Figma frame for „Back to shop“ in the portal header (desktop and mobile).

Label copy for both directions (cs, plus en as the source for translations).

The entry point is specified as visible only with the 

partnerPortal

 module active. Without the module, the admin header is unchanged.

Decision recorded: is „Back to shop“ temporary (and what replaces it), or does it stay?

Design reviewed with DevRel and aligned with 

.

### Open questions

- Q1: Does „Back to shop“ fit into the header that  strips down to logo and user pill, or does it go into the user dropdown?
- Q2: Is the entry a plain link/icon in the header, or a switcher like the shop switcher (`MarketsMenu`)?
- Q3: Should the hidden menu row be removed entirely, or kept as a fallback?

### Technical notes

_Generated by Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-10-07_

The portal runs inside the partner's own project, so the switch is just a layout change within one session and one project. It is not a jump to another shop. There is a module-gated header precedent at `admin/templates/after_header/headerNavigation.tpl:11` (`$modules->isActive("shoptetUniversity")`), and `MarketsMenu.tpl` (included at `:120`) is an existing switcher pattern.
